# Java Web SAST Scan

Read state and checkpoint first, then focus on Java, Spring MVC/Boot, Struts, Servlet/web.xml, JSP, filters, interceptors, and Spring Security. Inventory mappings before tracing source-to-sink flows. Check injection, authorization, CSRF, JWT/session, XXE, deserialization, command execution, JSP/EL, unsafe upload, redirects, SSRF, and security headers. Save evidence and findings in the framework format, redact secrets, checkpoint after each meaningful unit, and update reports/state before and after execution. Do not modify application source code.
